name: ATR-confirmed momentum breakout
rationale: A strong N-day advance that occurs while daily true range is ELEVATED is a real, conviction-backed breakout with participation behind it; the same return on a quiet, low-ATR tape is usually a thin drift that mean-reverts. Requiring both a positive momentum leg (ret_Nd) AND elevated volatility (atr, measured as ATR/close) selects volatility-confirmed moves and filters the dead-tape false breakouts.
catalyst: Range expansion: a momentum thrust coinciding with a jump in average true range marks a genuine breakout from compression, where the expanding daily range signals new information / fresh participation driving continuation rather than noise.
